task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to With the left arm, take the rectangular seal with decorative carvings and mark Cyan.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂，取出带有装饰雕刻的矩形印章并标记青色。
